Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
IIRC, several cards have the condition "since your last turn". What
does this mean exactly? Does it mean "since the start of your last
turn" or "since the end of your last turn" or something else?

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From Petri Wessman <or...@termiitti.akumiitti.fi>
=====

>IIRC, several cards have the condition "since your last turn". What
>does this mean exactly? Does it mean "since the start of your last
>turn" or "since the end of your last turn" or something else?

The latter.
Like "I haven't eaten since Monday" allows that I may have eaten on Monday
itself - but I haven't eaten since. "The best movie since 'Gone with The
Wind'" means that the movie isn't as good as 'Gone with the Wind', but
is better than anything after it.

Hmmm... so what about this particular situation then:

I Mind Rape Rufina Soledad and temporarily take control of her. I make

>I Mind Rape Rufina Soledad and temporarily take control of her. I make
>Rufina visit a Rave to give her blood to another vampire of mine and then
>while she is tapped play Force of Will to bleed for 2 and burn her.
>
>For my next trick, I decide to play Daemonic Possesion to ressurect Rufina
>Soledad into my ready region.

"Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has been
burned since your last turn. "

She was not controlled by another Methuselah when she burned, so does
not fulfil the requirements.

>Will I have to wait until my next turn to do this?

Were the card possible, no. If you were to wait until your next turn,
this wouldn't "since your last turn".
